paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis
notes: Paper derives first 95% CL exclusion on (ma, g_agamma) from Fermi-LAT observations of GW170817 (purple shaded region in Fig. 4). This is a new astrophysical (non-DM-halo) limit, so no local DM density assumption applies. No numerical table of the exclusion contour is provided; the only explicit numerical (ma, g) values in the text are Benchmark 1 (398 MeV, 5.01e-11 GeV^-1) and Benchmark 2 (200 MeV, 1.41e-12 GeV^-1), which the paper describes as 'currently unconstrained by other methods' and which lie in/near the constrained region of Fig. 4. These benchmarks are reported here as indicative points only — the actual exclusion contour must be digitized from Fig. 4. Paper also presents future projections (stacked mergers, closer merger, improved instruments) which are NOT included in data_points.
